About

SEO for the Google and AI search era.

SEO Executive and Lead Content Strategist with 5+ years of experience, currently managing 25+ client accounts at Allure Digital.

I deliver 40-70% organic traffic growth within 3-6 months and first-page rankings for clients across the USA, UK and Canada. I handle the full SEO lifecycle: technical audits, on-page, off-page, GMB optimisation and AEO-driven content, and I lead and mentor the junior writers and freelancers who deliver it.

With a Bachelor of Software Engineering, I understand how websites are built, not just how they rank. That helps me solve crawl, rendering and structured data problems most content professionals can't see.

AEO

Answer Engine Optimization. Direct answers, FAQ and schema markup to win featured snippets, People Also Ask and voice search.

GEO

Generative Engine Optimization. Entity-rich, authoritative content so ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude cite your brand.

Content structure and E-E-A-T signals built to appear inside Google AI Overviews.
